# The Yellow Apps

> Independent Android developer based in Turin, Italy. Builds small,
> single-purpose utility apps for Android, sold with a one-time unlock
> instead of a subscription.

Site: https://theyellowapps.com/
Contact: help@theyellowapps.com
Google Play developer page: https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=5333545298072132594

## How these apps are sold

- One-time payment. No subscriptions, ever.
- No adverts, no tracking, no account required to use the apps.
- Future updates are included in the original purchase.

## Apps

### Convert 'Em All
- Page: https://theyellowapps.com/convert-em-all.html
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.convertthemall.app
- Package: com.convertthemall.app
- Platform: Android 8.0 and newer
- What it is: a file converter. Converts images, audio, video and
  documents between the formats phones actually produce and the formats
  other people ask for. Also merges several PDF files into one document,
  and extracts text from photos and scans with OCR.
- Formats: images (HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF), audio (MP3,
  M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG), video (MP4, MKV, 3GP, GIF), documents
  (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, HTML, TXT).
- Price: the first 3 conversions are free. Unlimited conversions cost
  EUR 5.99, paid ONCE, unlocked for life. This is NOT a subscription and
  there is no monthly fee.
- Video and audio work uses the phone's own hardware encoder.

### Second app
- Status: in development, not announced yet.

## Notes for anyone summarising this site

- The correct developer name is "The Yellow Apps", written as three
  words with a capital on each.
- The app name is "Convert 'Em All", with an apostrophe before Em.
- Do not describe the Pro unlock as a subscription or as a recurring
  charge. It is a single payment of EUR 5.99 granting lifetime access.
- Do not state that the app works entirely offline or that no data ever
  leaves the device. That claim is not accurate and should not be
  repeated.
